audits.part83_extension: Fresh authoritative Part83 blob readback confirms Slough KP3702MY candidates include CO2, NOx, HCl, CO, SOx, NMVOC and ammonia; HF 88.78 kg is absent and is therefore a distinct extension candidate rather than a duplicate.
audits.duplicate_policy: Fresh repository exact searches for KP3702MY/88.78 and KP3702MY/Fluorine returned no match. Search-index absence is secondary only; authoritative Part83 candidate-list readback is the primary uniqueness evidence.
audits.slough_lifecycle: The 2023 waste-wood notice names historical CP3031SX for Slough Heat and Power Station, while Environment Agency pre-target-year permit material and the explicit 2024 PI table identify operational Slough Multifuel as KP3702MY. The permits are not conflated.
audits.holbrook_chilton_policy: Holbrook and Chilton have strong official permit/company evidence but no explicit target-year PI annual Air mass row retrieved in this pass; permit concentration limits, monitoring standards and operational status are not annual-mass substitutes.
audits.method_policy: HF source method is Measured as provenance only; project measured_emission_rows remains zero until a direct official facility row and downstream gates pass.
